title: 甲辰年年终祈福酬神法会
title_en: Jiachen Year Year-End Prayer and Divine Thanksgiving Ceremony
body: 年终举行祈福酬神法会，感谢神明护佑，祈求新年平安吉祥，体现道教感恩与祈愿的精神传统。
body_en: Held year-end prayer and divine thanksgiving ceremonies to express gratitude for divine protection and pray for peace and prosperity in the new year, embodying Taoist traditions of gratitude and aspiration.
